checks.before: SCFA_YIELD butyrate: Bifidobacterium .10, Akkermansia .15, L. reuteri .10 - none produce butyrate

evidence.supports: Bifidobacterium makes lactate; butyrate comes from cross-feeding partners (Megasphaera)
Rios-Covian 2016 SCFA review: butyrate producers are F. prausnitzii/Roseburia/Eubacterium clostridial clusters; Bifidobacterium -> acetate+lactate, Akkermansia -> acetate+propionate
Louis et al: colonic butyrate producers are specific clostridial clusters

checks.after: butyrate zeroed for the three non-producers; F. prausnitzii .75 and Roseburia .70 intact

checks.before: np.roll Laplacian = periodic boundary: proximal compartment exchanged directly with distal as if the gut were a ring
checks.after: zero-padded chain Laplacian (_migration, module-level and testable); endpoints have one neighbour; column sums 0 so mass conservation identical
checks.numeric_delta: final relative abundances shift by <= 2.0e-5 on the standard 28-day inulin run (compartments start identical, so the wrap term is near-zero in practice - structural fix, tiny numeric effect)

checks.detail: constraint_based_fiber_flux matches the analytic optimum biomass = yield_i * sum_j(dose_j * access_ij) with uptake at bounds, all 5 strains (e.g. Bifido 4.611, Akkermansia 1.2455)
Michaelis-Menten fermentation conserves mass to 3.6e-15 over 48 h (products split .55/.25/.20 sum to 1)
barrier/insulin/inflammation/efficacy reproduce their formulas exactly (IBD: efficacy .55*(1-inflammation)+.45*barrier = 0.690663)

verdict: TWO BUGS FIXED (75, 76): butyrate mis-curation for three non-producer strains (literature-anchored constants fix); periodic migration boundary replaced by a chain Laplacian.
negatives: enzymatic_fiber_fermentation km = .4+.08*j is fiber-INDEX dependent (list order, not chemistry) - arbitrary but consistent; documented, not redesigned
ENZYME_ACCESS is a curated hermetic fixture (module says so); spot-checked entries align with biology (Akkermansia mucin 1.0, Bifido GOS .95) but a full curation audit was not done
migration fix has near-zero numeric effect because compartments always start identical (z0 = tile) - users cannot set per-compartment initials
time_to_half_shift_days compares an L1 distance against a Bray-Curtis-normalized threshold (mixed scales) - documented
notes: 3 PubMed anchors fetched live via Entrez, titles verified
